reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 6 (p0047) runs in Client's favor (documentation and dispute rights), § 8(f) (p0058) is a spamming/technical-measures self-help right on TrueLink's own platform rather than an audit or inspection right, and § 3(e) (p0037) gives Client — not TrueLink — access to usage statistics and logs. No Customer-side audit, inspection, records or verification right is present.

Absence of any audit right against the Customer is more favorable than the preferred position (annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost, no system access), so no redline or comment is warranted; the proposal correctly leaves the text unchanged.
The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a false signal here — there is no audit clause to constrain, so the regex could not match; it does not indicate a deviation.
Redline is byte-identical to the originals and the comment is empty, consistent with a compliant finding retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
